calculation.description: Negative three-session smoothed close-location value, scaled by the asset's current relative daily range versus its 20-session median relative range. Negative orientation is selected because expansion-associated close-location moves reversed cross-sectionally in validation.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive after sign inversion in all tested regimes: 2020-2022 0.052423, 2023-2024 0.046598, 2025-2027-02-10 0.056233. Cross-section is the 15-asset benchmark universe; dates require at least 8 valid instruments.
